# Release Version: 22.04.01\_\_stable\_\_0.65.0

### Release Date: 04/01/2022

## New Features

## Updates

* The contact data generated by the **DataGenerator** has been modified in such a way that now it is obvious that they were generated.
* We have now **disabled** the gathering of old **location statistics**, to which access was disabled in **version 0.55**.

### System Updates

* We have **cleaned up** more **duplicate request logs** which will reduce the size of logs kept on installations.

## Resolved Issues

### System Fixes

* We have fixed the issue with the **FlowDiagram** where you can see more details while hovering over a specific section when there are numerous entries. Also the tooltip is now shown in its entirety.
